name: Arena announcer
design: Very tall lean male with dark copper-brown hide and charcoal speckles, elongated exposed mandibled skull, long dreadlocks swept over one shoulder. Sleeveless golden-ochre robe with dark short asymmetrical capelet, crossed narrow leather chest straps and bronze clasps, calf wraps. Holds a short curved ceremonial signal horn against right hip, left hand open beside belt. No mouthpiece touching face.
